newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta bourse temporarily suspends eight firms.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta bourse temporarily suspends eight firms.

text.p: The Jakarta stock exchange on Monday temporarily suspended eight securities companies as six of them were late in payments while the other two had failed to deliver shares, the official said.
"We have temporarliy suspended the trading of eight securities companies starting this morning," an official from the bourse's supervising department told Reuters.
"But if they can fulfill their obligations today, there is a possibility they can resume trading today," he said.

He said the companies which were late in payments were Lippo Securities, Waterfront Securities Indonesia, Asjaya Indosurya Securities, Srikandi Securitas Invesindo, Bhakti Investama and Kes Sinarmas Securities.
Danareksa Securities and Muara Lentera Mitra were suspended because they had failed to deliver shares, he added.
At 0405 GMT, the Jakarta stock index had lost 8.08 percent, or 50.66 points, to 567.05 in what brokers said was the biggest one-day drop in the stock market's history.
